paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved +0.17% on average, with Nasdaq strongest (+1.19%) and Hang Seng weakest (-2.60%). Brent crude changed -0.06% to 102.25. Gold changed -0.95% to 4,162.2998. Bitcoin changed +1.25% to 85,819.7266. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.277%, a relative move of +0.76%. Among the firms tracked, Freeport-McMoRan (+3.98%) and Glencore (+2.95%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: Schneider Electric nears deal to buy software group PTC for $20bn (FT Home). Acquisition would be French group’s largest and expand its industrial software capability Deals and capital markets: AkzoNobel nears deal to sell its SE Asia decorative paint unit to Nippon Paint (FT Companies). Dutch group on verge of handing Japanese rival a small victory as it seeks to exit non-core markets ahead of Axalta merger Central banks and macro: Dealmaking slowdown threatens early end to M&A boom (FT World). Interest rate rises, AI anxiety and midterm elections cool animal spirits after record-breaking start to the year Geopolitics and trade: EU countries shoot themselves in the foot when they veto sanctions (FT World). A recent move by France makes talk of ‘strategic autonomy’ look like hot air Geopolitics and trade: Russia strikes Kyiv as Germany’s Merz visits (FT World). Trip comes as Russia expands its air war against Ukraine ahead of winter and escalates ‘hybrid’ attacks on Europe
